overview: In August 2004, a naked and injured man was found behind a Burger King in rural Georgia. Claiming to suffer from a rare form of amnesia, he called himself Benjaman Kyle. In 2014, with the help of filmmakers Shannon and Eric Evangelista, he set out to piece together his forgotten life. But as cracks in his story emerged, producers uncovered realities that revealed disturbing inconsistencies in his past, revealing three cold cases and a possible connection to a powerful Midwestern crime family. As new evidence surfaces, the producers face mounting threats, placing one of their own in danger and revealing the devastating cost that can come with chasing the truth.
title: The Many Lives of Benjaman Kyle

overview: The Maine Cabin Masters take on their most ambitious build yet: transforming a rundown B&B into a stunning 12-acre lakeside inn. Along the way, Chase and his wife, Sarah, bring their long-held dream of becoming innkeepers to life.
title: Maine Cabin Masters: All Inn

overview: Chip buys a sprawling Texas mansion he swears is a great opportunity only to end up with a serious money pit. With no buyer after years on the market, Joanna steps in to transform the outdated estate into a beautiful home that—fingers crossed—will finally sell.
title: Fixer Upper: We Bought a Money Pit

overview: Most Extreme Humans follows people from around the globe living with the world's rarest and most remarkable physical conditions. From a Filipino man whose hands have grown so large he wears wristwatches as rings, to Brazil, where the world's smallest married couple have a combined height under six feet, to a 19-year-old in India living with the ultra-rare condition known as "werewolf syndrome." This series examines what everyday life looks like when the world is not built with your body in mind.
title: Most Extreme Humans

overview: Documentary series following people who have had their identities stolen.
title: ID Fraud

overview: Little Singles features a tight-knit group of friends from the little person community as they come together for an unforgettable vacation under one roof. For years, these friends have met annually at national conventions and have become a chosen family. The closeness they share carries the drama of complex relationships, romantic entanglements …and a whole lot of fun!
title: Little Singles

overview: Real patients revisit their most intense ER experiences, combining firsthand interviews with raw footage of the emergency as it happened, while ER doctors break down in real time what happened and why.
title: ER: Caught on Camera

overview: Jonathan Miller presents this documentary exploring the complexities of language.
title: Born Talking: A Personal Inquiry Into Language

overview: Barbaric centers on a ruthless and crass barbarian who is cursed to only use his violence for good, which sends him, his talking axe and a young witch on a road of self discovery, redemption and revenge.
title: Barbaric
Tui Hun Hou，Wo Dui Fu Ren Si Chan Lan Da

overview: Fresh out of college, a tight-knit group of friends, exes and rivals returns to hillside SoCal luxury and unfinished drama in this opulent reality series.
title: Calabasas Confidential

overview: After the fall of the Third Reich, details about the private lives of Nazi leaders came to light. Film footage and photographs reveal the daily lives of Hitler, Göring, Goebbels, and Bormann, as well as the lives of Germans under the dictatorship.
title: Das Dritte Reich Privat

overview: Connect with Jacob Soboroff will be the network's first Los Angeles-based program. Built around the connection Soboroff has forged with the MS NOW audience for more than a decade, Connect will bring viewers closer to the stories shaping the country. Connect will also bring Soboroff's storied reporting from the ground in Los Angeles and beyond to help connect the dots between what's happening in local communities throughout the country and larger national conversations driving politics, culture, and daily life.
title: Connect with Jacob Soboroff

overview: 5 male students enrolls at a school that has all female students. The boarding school was formerly an all-girls high school until the new school year. The student council then places the 5 male students in a place known as the prison on charges that they were peeping on the girls in the showers. The 5 male students struggle to escape from the prison. Based on the manga series with the same name by Hiramoto Akira.
title: Prison School

overview: The Moment with Katy Tur is designed to move beyond the immediate headlines to provide deeper context and understanding of the political and national stories shaping the day.
title: The Moment with Katy Tur

overview: On the Line with Alicia Menendez moves beyond the headlines to examine the stories shaping the nation, featuring one-on-one conversations with newsmakers and a focus on voices often left out of the political discourse
title: On the Line with Alicia Menendez

overview: Money, Power, Politics with Stephanie Ruhle, utilizing her extensive Wall Street background to analyze the high-stakes intersection of money, power, and politics, Stephanie Ruhle delivers original reporting and hard-hitting interviews on the stories that directly affect Americans' lives. The program focuses on business and political news, featuring the "Nightcap" roundtable segment from her previous show, The 11th Hour
title: Money, Power, Politics with Stephanie Ruhle
Mi Shu Da Ren Bu Hao Re

overview: Bernard Righton (John Thomson) introduces clips of famous stand-up comedians.
title: Legends of Stand-Up

overview: They're young, gifted and Black — and ready for a freshman year they won't forget. Meet the tightest crew at the country's top HBCU.
title: A Different World

overview: When the Human Vapor announces a killing spree, panic erupts. A reporter and detective close in on the truth — and face Mufu, pulling society's strings.
title: Human Vapor

overview: The men's national team is ready for the World Cup for the first time in 28 years. But how will they learn from their past mistakes and avoid the same fate as the United States?
title: Vi skal til VM!

overview: Celebrities investigate their Welsh heritage.
title: Coming Home
Shou Fu Da Ren De Xiao Jiao Qi
Wo Bi Xu Zhan You Ni
Hui Jia De Mo Sheng Ren

overview: Across the globe, engineers are creating extraordinary modern masterpieces, structures that push beyond the limits of what came before. Each year, innovations grow more impressive as bridges, tunnels, skyscrapers and even spacecraft become bigger, bolder and more ambitious. Yet, every breakthrough brings new risks. To ensure the safest outcomes, engineers must study worst-case scenarios in which major structures are pushed to their limits and fatal flaws are exposed. Fires, explosions, floods and catastrophic collisions are difficult to confront but essential to understand. In this series, we learn from the past to build a safer future.
title: Engineering by Catastrophe
Tou Ting Wu Sui Xiao Yi Xin Sheng，Zheng Dun Shang Hai Tan
The Princess Came From The Demon World
Ta Chi Lai De Jiu Shu
Shu Zhong Yao Nu Lai Xian Dai Shi Jie Nue Zha
Leng Qing Nue Ai：Fu Xian Sheng De Di Yi Zui Qi

overview: Millie Inbetween is a children's comedy series broadcast on CBBC. Millie's parents have just broken up and she and her sister Lauren are spending time at both their Mum's house and Dad's flat. Millie soon sees the advantage to this family set-up as she has two chances to celebrate Christmas, two birthdays and two bedrooms. Problems arise though after her parents find new partners.
title: Millie Inbetween

overview: In the flourishing Tang Dynasty, Li Jinglan, the gifted daughter of a prefect, possesses an extraordinary talent for forensic investigation and solving mysteries through autopsy. Together with the enigmatic "Ghost Detective" Jueming and the highly skilled constable Su Yu'an, she embarks on a series of perilous investigations, unraveling one bizarre case after another: the deadly identity swap of twin sisters, a scholar's wrongful conviction buried for seventeen years, and a string of ritualistic murders committed during an elegant literary gathering. Amidst bloodshed and deception, Li Jinglan and Jueming gradually develop deep feelings for one another, supporting each other while steadfastly upholding justice and breaking free from the shackles of fate. Beneath the dazzling lights of the prosperous empire, they use wisdom and courage to cleanse corruption and darkness, forging a legendary tale of righteousness, truth, and integrity.
title: Tang Dynasty Occult Mysteries

overview: In the age of new media, Jiang Zi is an ordinary and unlucky girl who keeps pushing forward, longing to be seen. Determined to become a content creator, she quits her stable job in her hometown and moves alone to Beijing. There, she gets the opportunity to work with her former idol, Ivy. The two become both rivals and friends — admiring each other while constantly competing. Smart, capable, and fearless, Jiang Zi gradually carves out her own place in the fast-paced world of new media. Along the way, she meets Luo Xin, an adorably awkward engineer. What begins as a bickering relationship slowly turns into deep companionship. Luo Xin becomes her refuge from the pressures of the workplace and the person who pulls her out of despair. But just as Jiang Zi reaches the peak of success, she begins to question the true meaning of her work in the new media industry. After a major mistake, she is sidelined by her company and falls to the lowest point in her career. With the support of Luo Xin and Ivy, Jiang Zi eventually finds the strength to reinvent herself, achieving both personal growth and a new breakthrough in her career.
title: Life is Elsewhere

overview: Thousands of years ago, a little demoness on a tree fell in love with the God of Water. After a tragic and disappointing love story with him, she lived alone in the present world and became the owner of a dessert shop called "Everlasting." She brews a tea known as "Floating Life," and many strange customers come to her shop. Each guest, after drinking the tea, tells a story—a tale of love, hatred, and heartbreaking passion among demons: a handsome demon boy who falls in love with a fish, a magical fox who protects a prophetic flower, a golden lion roaring at the sky to save his beloved, and a midnight butterfly warrior burdened by a strange past who slays demons… Every customer who visits the dessert shop has a story. And like the "Floating Life" tea, each story blends bitterness and sweetness after countless twists and turns. The tree demoness listens quietly to their tales. Yet she herself is still searching for her own path in life. Her journey involves Zi Miao, Jiu Gui, Ao Qi, the fat man, and the thin man… In the end, where will they all go?
title: Tales of the Floating World
Qiang Wen Shi Zun Hou Wo Chong Sheng Le

overview: During the era of warlord chaos, an old medic and drunkard known as Old Drunkard returns to his hometown and takes shelter in the Bone Resting Temple. There, he saves a widow, Ru Ling, and exposes the sinister conspiracy behind the "Mountain God Child Sacrifice," eventually taking up the mantle of the Light Keeper. He takes the wayward youth Dong Sheng under his wing, helps him crack an arms smuggling case, and rescues Qiu Ying from being offered as a living sacrifice. With wit and grit, he battles a vicious cult and liberates imprisoned patriots. In the end, Old Drunkard passes away in peace, and every life he saved goes on to devote themselves to the revolution.
title: LightKeeper of Jigu Temple

overview: Entertaining new series that meets some of the people behind the chicken business.
title: The Chicken People

overview: The Sainz Group is a leading enterprise in human quantum technology in the future world, and they are developing a quantum computer that can travel through time and space.
title: The Another Universe

overview: Salt.Legend is a new music show on the REN-TV and VK Video channels, where famous artists will meet on the same stage and try their hand at the most "tough" genre – Russian rock! Pop music has always been considered fake and plastic in people's minds, and pop artists have been seen as production projects that don't know anything. Therefore, in our show, we will give pop musicians live bands, guitars, and a live backing line so that they can show that they are also real musicians. The people who were at the origins of music in Russia – the soloists of cult rock bands and invited jury members – will evaluate the boldness of this musical experiment. Together with the audience, they will determine who is truly worthy of the title of "Legend of Russian Music".
title: Соль. Легенда
Yue Shang Han Xing Zhi Wu Bao Shi Cheng

overview: This Land traces America's rise from a fragile string of colonies to a continent-spanning superpower - as told by experts and descendants of the men and women whose sacrifices and struggles shaped the nation we live in today. Explore the history of America's expansion through six defining frontiers.
title: This Land

overview: The drama is set in democratic Ireland in the late 1970s. Charlie Haughey is the Taoiseach of Ireland, and his loyal servant, P.J Mara. The main focus of the drama is on Haughey and his circle, and the drama largely remains true to life while capturing the excitement and menace that was in the air.
title: Charlie

overview: When professional boxer Zack and sports journalist Nick inexplicably find themselves in a time loop, the two must work together to figure out what destiny wants them to fix as they are forced to relive the same day over and over again.
title: Round One

overview: Mike Elliot and his team of scrap metal junkies are the Outback Wreckers – their mission - to scour the harsh Aussie landscape for wrecked and abandoned cars, in search of valuable parts to be stripped out and sold for export. As Mike always says, ‘one's man's scrap is another man's gold' and business is booming for the team of Outback Wreckers! The Australian Outback is littered with dumped and damaged cars and the Outback Wreckers make it their mission to clean it up and make some cash along the way.
title: Outback Wreckers

overview: In Mom's the Bride, each episode follows an adult woman who is planning her mother's dream wedding, with help from Erin Cahill and Hallmark. Flipping the script on the traditional "mother of the bride" role, the series honors the reciprocal love and support that can make the mother-daughter bond so profound. Viewers will follow the road to the altar from planning, to cake tastings, to dress fittings and the big day. Every ceremony is a love letter from a daughter to her mother.
title: Mom's the Bride

overview: 1950s Hollywood was a fairytale city of movies, glamour, money, and fame, a dreamland that the world had never seen before. At its heart was the biggest star of them all, Marilyn Monroe. But beneath the glitz lay a much darker reality - the brutal and cold-hearted mob that had its claws in the entertainment industry and manipulated the most famous faces of the era – including Marilyn, a superstar whose iconic life was shadowed by dangerous liaisons, including her alleged affairs with both John and Robert Kennedy and rumoured Mafia connections. This two-part documentary takes a deep dive into the final weeks of her life, investigating her relationship with known mobsters like Sam Giancana and how she became a pawn in the Mafia's power plays. As we explore the blurred lines between Hollywood, politics, and organized crime, the series speculates on whether Monroe knew too much and whether her death was more than a tragic overdose. With archive footage, high-end graphics and expert interviews, we will uncover how Marilyn was used, abused, and ultimately lost in a game of power, politics, and betrayal, to explore one of the most infamous intersections of celebrity, crime, and political scandal in American history
title: Marilyn and the Mob

overview: Mums v. Dads in the first ever game show that puts the skills required to be a parent to the ultimate test.
title: Parents Know Best!

overview: A brand new quiz with a great big twist. It's not about how smart you are, but how smart your rivals think you are. Expect lying, scheming, and a whole lot of quizzing.
title: Nobody's Fool

overview: A pregnant woman navigates life as a single mom in Barcelona, facing ups and downs as she raises her toddler son in the vibrant Spanish city.
title: Yo siempre a veces

overview: In this series, Terry Jones presents the recounting of the religious wars for control of the "Holy Lands" waged by Christian Europe against the Islamic world. In addition, Terry Jones recreates specific aspects of those events by exploring the lives of pivotal figures, the technology and the politics of the era. Furthermore, Terry Jones also shows how these acts of religious bigotry at its worst have led to many of the political and ethnic problems we have today.
title: Crusades

overview: Turning thirty, Ploydao has hopes for success in her career and her relationships, but she couldn't feel farther from it. She works for a capitalist organisation and their demands don't sit well with her at all. Fortunately, she meets Namkhang, a psychologist whose advice leads her to quit her job and gives her the chance to restore relations with old friends, including former-boyfriend Chanin who's now running an enormous clothing business.
title: It's Ok to Be 30

overview: The story of three single, very different brothers. The oldest, Earth, born in 1983, is fastidious, loves kids, and wants to have a family. He's so freaking picky, though—he's got no chance of finding a wife. The middle brother, Win, born in 1987, is a handsome playboy, loves the single life, doesn't want to be tied down and can't stand kids. The youngest, Sun, born in 1993, is a foul-mouthed student, obnoxious in the way of Gen ME and always finds new ways to cause his brothers a headache. One day, the brothers learn their father who left them when they were young has passed away, leaving behind their five-year-old half-sister Cher. Unable to bear seeing her end up in the foster system, they adopt her.
title: Ban Saran Land: Suparburoot Sut Soi

overview: A filmmaker's decade-long investigation into the campus culture wars that have redefined free speech and civil discourse, in the very places that were meant to protect those ideals.
title: Speechless

overview: Follows a sprawling, multi-generational family drama set in the world of the NFL.
title: The Land

overview: The Old Stories opens a window into the narratives that shaped Israel long before David took the throne. As the past unfolds with epic force, a young shepherd sees his own future reflected in the courage, failure, and obedience of those who came before him.
title: The Old Stories: Moses

overview: In a cinematic journey, explore the Lord's Prayer across the landscapes where Jesus first spoke it. Hosted by Brad Gray and featuring insights from N. T. Wright and other scholars, learn about the prayer's cultural, historical, and spiritual depth.
title: The Sacred Thread

overview: Celebrity Page (formally known as OK! TV) is an American entertainment news and gossip program that is based on the magazine of the same name that airs on Reelz TV. The series is being co-produced by OK! US parent company American Media, Unconventional Partners, and Trifecta Entertainment & Media. The series premiered on September 9, 2013. It is also broadcast several times daily on the cable network Reelz, which is a production partner in the program. OK!TV was renewed for a second season on January 15, 2014. The series focuses on pop culture, celebrity news, gossip and lifestyle, leveraging the content of OK! and sister publications RadarOnline, Shape, Men's Fitness, Star,Country Weekly, and Soap Opera Digest. The program is co-hosted by five correspondents, Julie Alexandria, Shandi Finnessey, Alex Miranda, Ron Pitts and Mayleen Ramey. The New York segments are anchored by Alexandria and Miranda, the Los Angeles segments are handled by Pitts and Finnessey, and the Las Vegas portion is anchored by Ramey.
title: Celebrity Page
